sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Sergio Hernandez, a 15-year-old Mexican national, was shot and killed by a U.S. Border Patrol agent. The agent stood inside the United States while Hernandez stood in Mexico. The lower court dismissed the family's claim. The Supreme Court must decide if the Constitution applies to this cross-border incident.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the geographic reach of constitutional protections. It determines if U.S. agents can use force against foreign nationals without legal consequence. The outcome shapes accountability for cross-border law enforcement actions.
